scorecards.inningsCommentary: India commenced their first innings at M Chinnaswamy Stadium, aiming to set an imposing baseline total. The centerpiece of the innings was a brilliant 90 from KL Rahul, complemented by a commanding 61-run stand between Cheteshwar Pujara and KL Rahul that absorbed bowling hostility and accelerated the scoring rate to 2.65 RPO. Australia's bowling response was spearheaded by Nathan Lyon (8/50), who generated sustained pressure and triggered critical breakthroughs to prevent runaway scoring. Folded for 189/10 (71.2 ov), India suffered an early setback, conceding vital first-innings momentum to Australia.

summaryTab.matchCommentary:
The Test match at M Chinnaswamy Stadium commenced with high tactical intensity as India posted 189/10 (71.2 ov) in their opening innings. In response, Australia countered with 276/10 (122.4 ov), setting the stage for a compelling contest of tactical endurance. Early sessions tested batting resolve against disciplined seam movement, with both attacks striving to gain the upper hand on a developing surface.

The defining turning point arrived during 8-Wicket Spell: Nathan Lyon (8/50), which irrevocably altered the trajectory of the match. As the match progressed through its pivotal middle stages, R Ashwin delivered a masterclass for India (11 Runs & 8 Wkts), absorbing intense pressure and tilting the momentum decisively. Crucial partnership stands and incisive bowling spells broke the opposition's resistance, shifting the control share (India 51%) and allowing India to dictate terms heading into the decisive sessions.

Entering the final innings, Australia faced an uphill battle under unrelenting scoreboard pressure. India's bowling unit, bolstered by Nathan Lyon (2 Runs & 8 Wkts), maintained relentless discipline and attacked the stumps relentlessly. Wicket clusters in the closing sessions dismantled any remaining resistance, sealing India won by 75 runs in comprehensive fashion.

Verdict: India's triumph was built on superior pressure absorption, clinical execution during critical moments, and the ability to dominate key sessions. While Australia produced fighting phases, India won the pivotal turning points and sustained higher tactical control across all five days to emerge as deserved victors.
